title: Che botte ragazzi!
writer: Bitto Albertini, Carlo Alberto Alfieri, Mario Caiano
actors: Klaus Kinski, Cheen Lie, Tommy Polgár
plot: A sinister town boss called Pat Barnes has exploited almost everyone in the town. If they don't succumb to his demands they normally end up dead. Barnes is finally brought down by Shanghai Joe and a smooth-talking snake-oil salesman.
